text.en:
The sum of five thousand six hundred and twenty eight dollars and fifteen cents, in money of the
United States, is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for
the purpose of paying the salaries and traveling expenses of the Philippine Civil Service Board and office
force, for the purchase of books for use in preparing civil service examination papers, and for a contingent
fund for the Board, for the period from December first, nineteen hundred, to and including March thirty-first,
nineteen hundred and one.

The Disbursing Officer of the United States Philippine Commission shall act as disbursing officer
for the Philippine Civil Service Board.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, January 12, 1901.
